title: Ofcom opens an investigation into Pornhub owner Aylo to determine whether it has complied with OSA requirements to prevent under-18s from accessing porn (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Ofcom opens an investigation into Pornhub owner Aylo to determine whether it has complied with OSA requirements to prevent under-18s from accessing porn — Britain's media regulator Ofcom said on Wednesday that it had opened an investigation into whether adult content platform Pornhub …
